title: Power series presentation over a minimal descended base
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative Noetherian ring and $l$ a field finite as an $R$-module [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-field]. Use the test category, predeformation categories, formal objects and versality of [def-sfb-artin-deformation-test-category]. Let $\mathcal F$ be a predeformation category on $\mathcal C_{R,l}$. All complete local algebras below are Noetherian, are complete for their maximal ideals, and have specified residue field $l$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. A morphism from a formal object $\alpha$ over $A$ to $\beta$ over $B$ consists of a local residue-preserving $R$-map $f:A\to B$ and compatible isomorphisms between the evaluations of $\alpha$ along $A\to B/\mathfrak m_B^n$ and $\beta_n$, for every $n\geq1$. Assume the following property (S1): for every $A_1\to A\leftarrow A_2$ in the test category with $A_2\to A$ surjective, every $x_i\in\mathcal F(A_i)$ and specified isomorphism between their evaluations over $A$ come from an object of $\mathcal F(A_1\times_A A_2)$ with isomorphisms to the $x_i$ inducing the specified isomorphism. Let $\xi$ over $C$ be versal, and let $\eta$ over $B$ have a morphism to $\xi$ over an injective local residue-preserving $R$-map $i:B\hookrightarrow C$. Suppose that for every local residue-preserving $R$-map $f:C\to A$ to a test algebra, the induced morphism from the evaluation of $\eta$ over $f(i(B))$ to $\xi_f$ is minimal: no proper test $R$-subalgebra of $f(i(B))$ admits a morphism of an object to that evaluation over the inclusion. Suppose also: For every formal object $\theta$ over a complete local algebra $E$ and every morphism $\theta\to\eta$, the underlying map $E\to B$ is surjective. Then $\eta$ is versal, and there exist $r\geq0$ and a $B$-algebra isomorphism $B[[t_1,\ldots,t_r]]\xrightarrow{\sim}C$, where the $B$-structure of $C$ is $i$ [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series]. This isomorphism is local and induces the identity on the specified residue field $l$.

source.place: Tag 06T3, lemma-descends-versal; hypotheses written explicitly from Tag 06T2, lemma-smallest-where-descends-versal

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-versal-formal-object-quasi-initial] to the versal object $\xi/C$ and the formal object $\eta/B$. It gives a morphism $\xi\to\eta$ over a local residue-preserving $R$-map $f:C\to B$. Composing with the given $\eta\to\xi$ gives a morphism $\eta\to\eta$ over $u=fi:B\to B$. The assumed surjectivity of every incoming formal-object map to $\eta$ applies to this composite, so $u$ is surjective.

The increasing ideals $\ker u^j$ stabilize: their union is an ideal, whose finitely many generators from [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] all occur in some $\ker u^N$. If $u(b)=0$, choose $z$ with $u^N(z)=b$ using surjectivity; then $z\in\ker u^{N+1}=\ker u^N$, so $b=0$. Thus $u$ is an isomorphism. Set $\rho=u^{-1}f$, a local residue-preserving $R$-map with $\rho i=\mathrm{id}_B$. For $I=\ker\rho$, the identity $c=i(\rho(c))+(c-i(\rho(c)))$ and $i(B)\cap I=0$ give $C=i(B)\oplus I$ additively.

source.place: Tag 06RN, lemma-surjective-endo-noetherian-ring-is-iso, kernel-chain proof; applied in Tag 06T3

proof.text: The ideal $I$ is finitely generated by [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], so the images of its generators span the $l$-vector space $I/\mathfrak m_CI$. Retain a maximal linearly independent subset and choose representatives $x_1,\ldots,x_r\in I$, allowing $r=0$. Apply the construction clause of [lem-sfb-split-local-power-series-section-criterion] to $i,\rho$ and these representatives. It gives the complete Noetherian local ring $S=B[[X_1,\ldots,X_r]]$, the continuous local $B$-map $\phi:S\to C$, $X_j\mapsto x_j$, and surjective maps $\phi_n:S/\mathfrak m_S^n\twoheadrightarrow C/\mathfrak m_C^n$ of test algebras.

Fix $n\geq1$, put $D_n=S/\mathfrak m_S^n$ and $A_n=C/\mathfrak m_C^n$, and let $y_n$ be the evaluation of $\eta$ under $B\to S\to D_n$. The given morphism $\eta\to\xi$ supplies an isomorphism $(\phi_n)_*y_n\cong\xi_{C\to A_n}$: both are evaluations along $B\xrightarrow{i}C\to A_n$, with the transport comparisons of [def-sfb-artin-deformation-test-category]. Apply precisely the specified-isomorphism lifting condition defining versality of $\xi$ to $D_n\twoheadrightarrow A_n$, $C\to A_n$ and $y_n$. It gives a local residue-preserving $R$-map $h_n:C\to D_n$ with $\phi_nh_n$ equal to the quotient map. Locality gives $h_n(\mathfrak m_C^n)\subseteq\mathfrak m_{D_n}^n=0$. Therefore $h_n$ factors through $\sigma_n:A_n\to D_n$, and $\phi_n\sigma_n=\mathrm{id}_{A_n}$. No $B$-linearity or compatibility among these sections is asserted.

All hypotheses of the final clause of [lem-sfb-split-local-power-series-section-criterion] now hold, with sections for every $n\geq1$. Hence $\phi:B[[X_1,\ldots,X_r]]\xrightarrow{\sim}C$ is a $B$-algebra isomorphism for the original inclusion $i$. Its construction makes it local and the identity on the marked residue field $l$.

To prove versality of $\eta$ directly from [def-sfb-artin-deformation-test-category], let $D\twoheadrightarrow A$ be any test-algebra surjection, $a:B\to A$ a local residue-preserving $R$-map, and $y\in\mathcal F(D)$ with a specified isomorphism $y|_A\cong\eta_a$. The map $a\rho:C\to A$ extends $a$ since $\rho i=1$. Evaluation of the given $\eta\to\xi$ identifies $\eta_a$ with $\xi_{a\rho}$; compose this with the specified isomorphism. Versality of $\xi$ gives a lift $b:C\to D$ of $a\rho$ and an isomorphism $y\cong\xi_b$ with the prescribed reduction. Restrict $b$ along $i$ to obtain $bi:B\to D$ lifting $a$. The same given morphism identifies $\xi_b$ with $\eta_{bi}$, and its transport comparisons ensure that the resulting isomorphism reduces to the originally specified one. This is exactly versality of $\eta$.

Step 1: lem-sfb-versal-formal-object-quasi-initial gives xi->eta over f, the composite eta->eta lies over fi, and 06T2(2) makes fi surjective. Step 2 writes out the 06RN kernel-chain argument; rho=u^{-1}f satisfies rho i=id, so C=i(B)+I as a direct sum. Step 4: S/m_S^n is a test object, and the versality definition of def-sfb-artin-deformation-test-category gives h_n with phi_n h_n=q; locality kills m_C^n, which gives the sections sigma_n. Step 6 proves eta versal directly from the definition: lift a.rho with versality of xi, then restrict along i, using rho i=id; the reduction of the isomorphism is checked through the pseudofunctor coherences. New node lem-sfb-split-local-power-series-section-criterion: it states Tag 06SG with the right-inverse reading that its proof uses. I proved it true without B-linearity of the sections: the cotangent spaces split as m_B/m_B^2 plus I/m_C I, sigma_n is cotangent-surjective and the identity on residue fields, so Nakayama and nilpotence make sigma_n surjective.
